established: At the packet's bounded diagnostic ceiling, all ten localhost site hostnames parse through the recorded tldextract output as registered_domain 'local.'; the true distinct registered-domain count is 1, not 10. This is an implementation-level observation, not evidence that independent external hosting is impossible.

The ten orthogonal pages each have 20 AX nodes and 13 named AX nodes but only 67-107 characters of DOM text, below the frozen DOM>=2000 gate. The artifact set records one qualifying real family, magento_136, with 1430 AX nodes and 56764 DOM-text characters; the current run therefore does not establish >=10 real constructible families.

The synthetic-site product-subtree Jaccard matrix has pairwise value 0.1111 while the recorded shuffled mean is 0.0909090909, for a gap of 0.0202 rather than the required 0.20. The threshold sweep is [1.0, 1.0, 0.9479], so its range is 0.0521 but the 0.818-to-0.90 delta is 0.0 rather than >=0.02.
The recorded full-tree-versus-truncated delta of 0.6667 is attached to one canonical family, not a family-level diverse census; it cannot satisfy the frozen family-grouped representation gate.
Branch A did not obtain WebGym data: HF_TOKEN was absent and two ServiceNow/WebGym API attempts returned 404. This is substrate unavailability, not falsification of WebGym diversity.
